question: What must be true for the business to grow: more volume, more locations, more partners, more offerings?

needs.need: The business needs to dynamically scale its micro-fulfillment network and partner onboarding processes to maintain ultra-fast delivery SLAs as it expands into new geographic zones.
needs.why: Growth in locations and partners introduces complexity that, if not managed, will degrade the core value proposition of speed and reliability, leading to customer churn.

needs.need: The business needs to implement scalable, automated quality assurance and dispute resolution workflows to handle increased order volume without compromising service standards.
needs.why: As volume and offerings grow, manual oversight becomes a bottleneck; automated quality control is essential to protect brand reputation and ensure consistent customer satisfaction.

needs.need: The business needs to establish flexible, data-driven revenue management and settlement mechanisms that adapt to diverse partner types and dynamic market conditions.
needs.why: Scaling the partner ecosystem requires a monetization model that can efficiently handle varying commission structures, multi-currency transactions, and real-time reconciliation to sustain profitability.
